status: provisional until the boxes are measured (roadmap 0004)

coordinates.origin: floor, front-left corner of the frame
coordinates.x: to the right, across the 3 columns
coordinates.y: to the back; the boxes pull out towards -y

box_envelope.footprint: 400 x 300, short side with the handle at the front

box_shape.status: UNVERIFIED, read from the aidB product photos of the closed-handle C2G43-12; the inner floor is SECONDARY (inner_floor_status); roadmap 0004 measures a box
box_shape.colour: neutral dark grey, about sRGB #3F3F3F on the lit faces of the photo
box_shape.inner_floor_status: box_models inner_floor_*: the inner wall tapers from the inner top to the floor. 120: SECONDARY, 359 x 259 is the inner floor of Bito XL43121 and Utz RAKO 400 x 300 x 120, and aidB's insert sets need at least 358 x 258. 220: DERIVED, the same wall slope over 215 instead of 115, 365 - 6 x 215 / 115 = 354

handle.handles: closed: a grip pocket, not an opening through the wall

clip.covers: the face of the handle frame, round the grip pocket

castor.head_diameter_status: SECONDARY, read as text from motedis' drawing of the same castor
castor.at: under a castor plate at each corner, centre 45 from both outer faces

frame.castors_at: the four corners, each under a castor plate below the bottom bar and the bottom depth beam

base.orientation: flat leg at the bottom on the bottom bars, vertical leg up

support_and_guard.orientation: flat leg on top, hanging leg down along the upright

box_position.note: centred in the 435 depth; no back stop

top_plate.role: structural: screwed to both top bars from below, plate and bar act as one composite chord that carries most of the middle uprights' load, so the bottom bar can be 30 x 30

mounts.note: bracket centres along each top bar, in its inner slot, free leg flush with the bar top under the plate; four in each outer bay where the shear acts, two in the middle bay where it is near zero; clear of the depth-beam brackets on the right of each upright; nothing shows on top

top_plate.visual_status: corner_radius R10 is the user's choice; plies, finish and colour are UNVERIFIED

inserts.system: NextGen Einsatzkaesten x-100 (aidB), bought as sets
inserts.taper_status: DERIVED from aidB's set tables (EES43-01-100-04, EES43-02-100-04): outer 366 x 266 x 100, inner 355 x 255 x 97; each tray wall moves in (366 - 355) / 2 - 1.5 = 4 from top to bottom, the floor is 100 - 97 = 3; reading the inner size as the floor is UNVERIFIED
inserts.layout_note: two rows across the 300 side, each 133 wide; the cells of a row run along the 400 side from the front
inserts.order: from fine to coarse, top to bottom: quarter on L5 and L4, half on L3 and L2, the 220 boxes on L1 without inserts

color_clips.rule: one colour per insert type, neighbouring cool hues, lighter towards the top: blue on the 220 boxes, turquoise on the half sets, light green on the quarter sets; both handles of a box
color_clips.srgb_note: UNVERIFIED, median ring colour in aidB's photos: red, yellow and blue from the ColorClip photo, turquoise and purple from the boxes with fitted rings, magenta, green and light green from the user's samples, checked against aidB's ColorClip photos within CIE76 8, black from its ColorClip photo with the shadows trimmed

presets.name: By box type, bold
presets.why: one colour per insert type; clear for every kind of colour vision

presets.name: By box type, calm
presets.why: one colour per insert type without red or yellow; the largest steps between the groups

presets.name: Five colours, every viewer
presets.why: a colour per level with large steps for normal and red-green colour vision

presets.name: Colour-blind safer
presets.why: a colour per level without red, so red-green colour vision keeps every step

presets.name: Complementary steps
presets.why: a colour per level, every pair of neighbouring levels close to complementary, so all four steps contrast alike

parts.description: Upright between the bars, M8 core thread at both ends, the bottom one extra deep (80 mm)
Top bar, front and back, one piece over all three columns; 4 through holes 8.5 with 14 mm counterbore
Bottom bar, front and back, one piece over all three columns, flush with the bottom depth beams; shares the middle uprights' load with the top plate and top bar; 4 through holes 8.5
Depth beam between the front and the back bar at each upright, the top one flush with the top bars, the bottom one flush with the underside of the bottom bars
Level 1 support, flat leg at the bottom on the bottom bars
Level 2-5 support, flat leg on top, hanging leg guides the box below
Tip guard above level 5, same section and orientation as angle.support

Inside angle bracket 30 for B-type slot 8: upright to top depth beam (8), top depth beam to bar (8), bottom depth beam to bar on the beam's bay side (8), a second one on the other side at the middle uprights (4)

Castor plate 90x90x10 under each corner, screwed into the bottom slots of the bottom bar and the bottom depth beam; M8 thread at 45/45 for the castor, 14 mm hole at 15/15 for the corner bolt head, 4 countersunk holes for M6
ISO 7380 M6x12 for the brackets, 2 per bracket.inside_30
ISO 10642 M6x16 from below through the castor plates into the bottom slots, 4 per plate
Hammer nut M6 B-type slot 8 for the brackets (56) and the castor plates (16)
ISO 10642 M5x10 for the angles, flush in a countersunk hole so the hanging leg stays smooth
Hammer nut M5 B-type slot 8 for the angles
ISO 4762 (DIN 912) M8x70 from below through the bottom bar into an upright's 80 mm core thread, 40 mm engaged; at a corner its head sits in the castor plate's 14 mm hole
ISO 4762 (DIN 912) M8x50 through the top bar into an upright, head sunk in the counterbore
ISO 4762 (DIN 912) M8x20 from inside the castor housing up through the back hole into the castor plate's M8 thread
ISO 7089 (DIN 125 A) washer 8.4 under the castor bolt's head inside the housing
Swivel castor 100 mm without brake, 125 high, back hole 11, offset 28, 70 kg, under a castor plate at each corner
End cap 30x30 for the ends of the top and the bottom bars
Eurobox NextGen 2.0 Cycle 400x300x120, closed handles, anthracite (C2G43-12)
Eurobox NextGen 2.0 Cycle 400x300x220, closed handles, anthracite (C2G43-22), no inserts
ColorClip set blue, 2 rings (R200-00-02-SET), level 1
ColorClip set turquoise, 2 rings (R200-00-12-SET), levels 2 and 3
ColorClip set light green, 2 rings (R200-00-13-SET), levels 4 and 5
Insert set 1/2 for 400x300x120 (EES43-01-100-04): 2 x NextGen 3613-100
Insert set 1/4 for 400x300x120 (EES43-02-100-04): 4 x NextGen 1813-100
Top plate, birch plywood, grain along the 1108 length, corners rounded R10; structural, screwed to the top bars from below
Angle bracket 30 with fixing set, swung into the top bars' inner slots, 10 per bar at top_plate.mounts.x
Wood screw 4.5x16, pan head, from below through a bracket into a pre-drilled hole in the plate, 1 per bracket; at least 5 mm of wood stays above the tip
